find:
if (mode !== undefined) params.push(['mode', mode]);
  if (players !== undefined) params.push(['players', String(players)]);
killedBy: co-op is its own named capture (issue #359) asks for the player slots even with no mode, which is what makes it co-op at all
why: Restores the shape these two lines had while versus was the only multi-player flow, and it is a real bug the moment co-op exists: `players` is emitted only alongside `mode`, so every `coop-round` request records a ONE-player campaign round. Nothing about the capture looks wrong -- the round plays, the overlay draws, the recorder reports its tick rate -- and the clip would be filed as evidence of enemy target distribution across co-op players who were never on the board. It was written this way for an hour before the URL was read back.
